PORTS AND AIRPORTS DEVELOPMENT LEVY ACT, No. 18 OF 2011
Order under Section 3

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Sub-section (3) of Section 3 of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011, I, Eran Wickramaratne, Acting Minister of Finance do hereby this Order amend the Schedule II of the Ordermade in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2049/16 of December 13, 2017, by addition to the said Schedule ofthe articles specified in the Column III corresponding to the HS Headings and HS Codes specified in the Column I and IIof the Schedule hereto, effective from May 07, 2019.
ERAN WICKRAMARATNE,Acting Minister of Finance.
Ministry of Finance,Colombo 01,May 07, 2019
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - PG 4513— 567 (05/2019)
